description: Es un vehículo robótico diseñado para explorar la superficie de otros planetas, como Marte o la Luna. Está equipado con sensores, cámaras y sistemas de navegación que le permiten desplazarse, analizar el terreno, detectar obstáculos y recopilar información científica sin necesidad de un conductor humano. Su objetivo es investigar el entorno y ayudar a comprender mejor el espacio.
summary: Robert Inteligente is an interactive, story-driven experience for young space enthusiasts. Guided by a curious rover, students explore NASA hardware left on the Moon and Mars through engaging, fact-checked stories. Each stop explains what the equipment was designed to do, how it worked, and what science it made possible. Synchronized narration, subtitles, and clear visuals make these forgotten explorers accessible and memorable.
details:
Robert Inteligente is an interactive educational experience that introduces students to NASA equipment left on the Moon and Mars. A rover guides them through short stories about past vehicles, landers, and scientific instruments: what each mission set out to do, how its equipment worked, and what discoveries it made possible. The experience is designed to make engineering accessible through engaging narration, synchronized audio, subtitles, and visual resources.

The physical prototype uses an ESP32 to control motors through an L298N H-bridge and read data from an HC-SR04 ultrasonic sensor, an FC-51 infrared sensor, and an MPU6050 inertial sensor. The RoverControl web dashboard sends commands and displays diagnostic data. Development tools include PlatformIO, the Arduino framework, C++, Python, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Ollama integration and Bluetooth control are planned for future development.

The project aims to spark interest in space exploration and STEM by connecting rover technology with the science made possible by historic missions. The team considered factual accuracy, the age of the audience, accessibility, and the distinction between features already tested and those still in development.
